Application Data.NAME: Telecom Innovations, Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Telecom Innovations, Inc. provides a comprehensive range of telecommunications services, including high-speed internet, cable television, and voice services to residential and business customers. Our operations focus on the installation, maintenance, and support of advanced communication technologies, ensuring reliable connectivity and superior customer service. We also offer consultation services for optimizing communication infrastructure. Our team adheres to strict regulatory compliance and emphasizes safety protocols in all operational processes.

Application Data.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Telecom Innovations, Inc. does not own or operate any other business locations besides its primary telecommunications operations.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 10, 2022, a cable installation truck was involved in a minor accident resulting in damage to the vehicle and property totaling $5,000. The claim was settled in April 2022. On July 15, 2023, we experienced a service outage affecting several customers due to equipment failure, which required urgent repairs costing $10,000. This claim is currently open and under review. Total losses to date amount to $15,000.
Application Data.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security patrols and perimeter fencing to enhance site security and deter unauthorized access.
